Owner-produced Assessment v1 / Findings v1 conformance fixtures.
preflight-assessment-v1 and preflight-findings-v1 are actual n4pf extraction outputs from the owner hand-authored synthetic migration report/context, with no metrics recomputed in Quality.
preflight-native-* are actual owner Preflight/native-provider output on the synthetic analytic fixture, retained from datasets-completion-native-proof-v3/test_real_preflight_count_and_current; includes the real domain_shift.design instrument/campaign identity collision. Both factors and all unknown/native fields must remain distinct. Native projected findings are actual n4pf extract-findings output on that exact report/context.
Numeric values are not refreshed or recalculated by this consumer. String schema1 is the actual current owner wire; the explicit String1.0 spelling is a compatibility case requested for Assessment1.0. Integer1 remains the separate QualificationReport. No Domains numerical engine or producer publication is claimed by schema tests.

Domains native report fixtures are exact public owner examples from
https://github.com/dcornet/nirs4all-domains/tree/378dc4ca752c3ab3e60f2514da1bdfa062e9a7da
examples/translation/report.json and examples/technical-repeats/report.json.
They retain their original historical Methods1.3.6 / ABI2.19 and native
Domains canonical.v0.2 provenance, not a claim of recomputation by Methods1310.
The accompanying report.v1.schema.json is the owner's current schema at that
same commit. The consumer supports explicitly inspected canonical.v0.2/v0.3.
Copyright original authors/contributors, AGPL-3.0-or-later; license text retained
alongside these tests. No Domains numerical engine is imported or implemented.

Preflight0.1.1 source-bound intrinsic-v1 fixtures are frozen from owner commit
881250d5fc26c3978cb0a3d9e25701a2deba05d2, with individual hashes in
preflight-011/source-receipt.json. The 95 metrics are native observations over the
explicitly synthetic canonical-input.json, not measurements from a real dataset.
Native factor and migration-example `*-011-*` fixtures were extracted by the
same owner's actual n4pf CLI, SHA256
2e0f0a7b773c4df1405db24148416a1423717ccff9fe76a6571edfc83fe6311e.
The CLI emitted each metric_context_id. Quality preserves these opaque identities;
it does not recreate the producer's hash algorithm or its scientific computations.
